item.title: 7 Budget Wall Decor Ideas for Small Apartments
item.description: Bare walls but a small budget? These 7 wall decor ideas add personality to a small apartment without clutter or big spending: large art, mirrors, plates, textiles and more. Renter-friendly options included.
